text: 2026年10月14日，中国人民银行行长潘功胜在泰国曼谷出席中国与海湾阿拉伯国家合作委员会（简称海合会）成员国第四次央行行长会。各方围绕投资往来、跨境支付、深化中国人民银行与海合会国家央行合作等议题进行了深入交流。
text_en: On October 14, 2026, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng attended the fourth meeting of central bank governors of China and the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) member states in Bangkok, Thailand. The parties held in-depth exchanges on topics including investment flows, cross-border payments, and deepening cooperation between the People's Bank of China and the central banks of GCC countries.
